Hi Marissa —

Yep, that aligns with our discussion. A couple of clarifying questions before we loop in our infra/security teams:

1) For Private VPC/on-prem: can Redwood support customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, or on-prem HSM) so that keys never leave our control?
2) For Dedicated: what guarantees do we get around logical tenant isolation? Is there hardware-level separation or just software multi-tenancy? We need to understand risk of co-residency.
3) Auditability: are all API calls, prompts, and responses logged with immutable audit records and timestamped entries? Is there an option to export logs to our SIEM?
4) Data residency: FinSecure requires US-only data processing and storage for this workload. Do your Private and Dedicated deployments allow region pinning?

If you can provide brief answers (high level) and a proposed time for an architecture call, we can get security and infra on the thread.

Hi Alex —

Thanks for the clear questions. High-level answers below; happy to deep-dive on the architecture call.

1) Customer-managed KMS:
- Private VPC/on-prem: We fully support customer-managed keys. For cloud-hosted Private VPC we can integrate with your AWS KMS or Azure Key Vault. For on-prem air-gapped deployments we support HSM integration (PKCS#11) so keys never leave your environment.
- Dedicated: By default encryption at rest uses Redwood-managed keys, but we offer a BYOK (bring-your-own-key) option for Dedicated deployments under an enterprise contract. BYOK for Dedicated requires additional provisioning and a short onboarding security review.

2) Isolation model:
- Private VPC: Network and tenancy are isolated to your VPC with no shared control plane access. You get dedicated compute in your VPC or on-prem with private networking and optional VPN/direct connect.
- Dedicated: Compute is dedicated to your org (no shared GPU instances) but control plane and management may be multi-tenant. Logical isolation is enforced via tenant-level namespaces and strict ACLs; we also offer contractual isolation addenda for high-risk customers. If you need hardware-bare isolation we recommend Private VPC/on-prem.

3) Auditability & logging:
- We provide per-request audit logs (request metadata, model version, token counts) and optional full payload logging. Logs can be exported in real time to your SIEM (via secure forwarder or S3 export) and are tamper-evident (signed entries).

4) Data residency:
- Both Private VPC and Dedicated can be region-pinned to US-only regions. For Private on-prem, processing stays within your environment.

Attachment: redwood-private-deployment-overview.pdf — section 3 covers KMS + audit log patterns.
